omp-seed.label: omp settings seed
omp-seed.implies: Reviews settings this machine kept over the repository defaults. Local only: no secret, no network, nothing downloaded.

machine-key.label: machine key
machine-key.implies: Mints this machine's age key on an operator device and stores it in the repository encrypted to the admins group; atyrode apply places it.

operator-identity.label: operator identity
operator-identity.implies: Mints this device's own age key (inside the Secure Enclave on a Mac, a plain age file elsewhere) and prints the two clan commands that register it as a member of the admins group. Local only: no secret is read, nothing is uploaded, and the key never leaves the device.

agent-context.label: generated agent context
agent-context.implies: Writes this machine's facts under the operator policy to ~/.config/agents/AGENTS.md, which every agent tool here reads. Asks gh and clever for their session state, stores no secret, downloads nothing.

git-identity.label: Git identity
git-identity.implies: Generates this machine's SSH auth and signing keys on an operator device, encrypted to the admins group; the next apply places them and Git reads them directly. The signing key is trusted only once a reviewed commit adds its public half to modules/home/git/allowed-signers. No vault and no agent on this machine.

declared-inputs.label: Declared generator inputs and managed links
declared-inputs.implies: Clan checks every declared file and its existing invalidation rules on an operator device; current apply places generated files and Home Manager links. No secret values are inspected and no keys are rotated.

babel-archive.label: Babel session archive
babel-archive.implies: Generates this machine's storage document on an operator device from the repository password, the add-on credentials, and the payload key ring typed once; the next apply places them and arms the hourly timer that publishes sessions. No vault and no provider session on this machine.

babel-analysis.label: Babel analysis worker profiles
babel-analysis.implies: Home Manager imports legacy Code profiles without changing their IDs or revisions, retains the source store, and asks Babel to migrate and validate configured worker launches offline. Preserves custom wrappers and account choices; no analysis, model calls, credentials, or service restart.

omp-auth-broker.label: OMP auth broker token
omp-auth-broker.implies: Generates the bearer token the fleet's one OMP auth broker and every client of it share, on an operator device; the next apply places it, and the broker host serves with it while every other machine tunnels to that host. No vault and no provider session on this machine.

local-qwen.label: local-qwen model runtime
local-qwen.implies: Builds a Docker image and downloads about 40 GB of model weights. No secret and no vault, but it is the largest thing this machine will fetch.

manifold-agent.label: Manifold fleet agent
manifold-agent.implies: Starts the native managed agent for the machine token activation placed. The token is this machine's clan var, minted by `atyrode runtime enroll manifold-agent <host>` on an operator device that holds the hub's owner key as a clan var this machine never receives. No vault and no owner key on this machine.

convergence.label: convergence to main
convergence.implies: Compares the revision this machine runs with the head of main. Read-only: nothing is activated here or by the hourly timer that records the same comparison for the shell; taking the update is atyrode apply, run by an operator.
